page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right. The left edge is cut off, so the first letters of many lines are missing from the scan. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ri certe ratione sanguis cum cæ-ris humoribus, imo cor & cere-um, & similia male dispofita no-int, quibus tamen bene dispositis ca-re neutiquam possumus.

Sed quandoquidem Democritum ftem suæ futilitatis infeliciter cita-t, idem litem hanc dirimat, qui Hippocratis judicio Philosophorum-nimus est, & cujus Philosophia m parum abest à Cartesii placitis, huic visum fuerit operæ prætium doctrinam Democriti à sua data ope-distinguere. Democritus igitur, i refert Hippocrates Epist. ad Da-agetum, postquam respondisset sese cupatum esse circa causas insaniæ & lis naturam ac sedem, subdit num:

nosti enim hanc, videlicet bilem, roris causam esse, (an simpliciter? fit. sed) ubi nimium redundarit; in mnibus equidem à natura inest: sed in ibusdam minus, in quibusdam am-ius. at ἀμετρίη immoderatio ipsius mor-

page.notes: Left edge of the scan is cropped, so initial letters of many lines are lost; those fragments are copied as they stand. The Greek words "ἀμετρίη" is partly obscured and may be read with doubt. Line-initial fragments such as "ri", "ftem", "ippocratis" are truncated by the scan edge.
